latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cosmetics-compliance-manager:

- Provides comprehensive support for cosmetics regulatory compliance, including regulatory queries, registration/filing guidance, technical standards, safety assessment, quality management, labelling, and supervision dynamics.
- Integrates national (NMPA), local, and international regulations and standards.
- Includes key compliance checklists, frequently asked questions, and up-to-date regulatory announcements.
- Offers direct access to official information sources and regulatory databases.
- Supports guidance on new ingredient management, production requirements, claims regulations, and international comparisons.
